designationHistory.indexText: The Fish and Wildlife Service Director first established the Wallkill River National Wildlife Refuge by an administrative decision document on March 9, 1990.
designationHistory.note: FWS-only source for the March 9, 1990 administrative action; no independent confirmation found.

sources.name: FWS, Wallkill River NWR Comprehensive Conservation Plan (2009), Appendix G

designationHistory.indexText: Congress confirmed the establishment of the 7,500-acre Wallkill River National Wildlife Refuge in Public Law 101-593, signed November 16, 1990.

authority.citation: Public Law 101-593, title I, 104 Stat. 2955 (Wallkill River National Wildlife Refuge Act)

designationHistory.note: Pass A (2009 CCP: Congress enacted Public Law 101-593, 104 Stat. 2955, on November 16, 1990, confirming the refuge) and Pass B (statute text on govinfo, dated Nov. 16, 1990, with the Wallkill River National Wildlife Refuge Act title) agree.

sources.name: FWS, Wallkill River NWR Comprehensive Conservation Plan (2009)
